title: Hearty Winey German Seitan Skillet
description: A weeknight German dish featuring seitan, red chilli flakes, and pickle, with a winey and cheesy flavor, served on a hot stone plate. This plant-based dish is perfect for a quick and satisfying dinner.
instructions: Heat a large hot stone plate over medium-high heat on the stovetop.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the seitan and cook until it is browned on all sides, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the red wine, vegetable broth, red chilli flakes, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced by half, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped pickle and cook for an additional minute.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the shredded vegan cheese until it is melted and the mixture is creamy.
Serve the seitan mixture hot on the hot stone plate, garnished with additional caraway seeds if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
